dockets_tail.description: *MINH THOMAS:WAIHOLUA-RODRIGUES: (jd) HON:10B: CV: (13:31-13:34) ATTY GLENN HORIO AND ATTY YUN KIM PRESENT BY ZOOM FOR PLTFF ASSOCIATION OF APARTMENT OWNERS OF MARINE SURF WAIKIKI, INC., A HAWAII NONPROFIT CORPORATION, BY ITS BOARD OF DIRECTORS. ATTY JAMES FERGUSON PRESENT BY ZOOM FOR PLTFF ASSOCIATION OF APARTMENT OWNERS OF MARINE SURF BY ITS BOARD OF DIRECTORS AS TO COUNTERCLAIMS. ATTY AMANDA DUTCHER PRESENT BY ZOOM FOR DEFT NIKODEM PIKOR. COURT NOTED THAT THE COURT IS NOT COMFORTABLE SIGNING STIP TO CONTINUE; NO FACTUAL DISPUTES; ATTY DUTCHER HAS A MOTION TO WITHDRAW AS COUNSEL AND REQUESTS STIP TO CONTINUE THIS MATTER TO THE SAME DAY AS THE MOTION DUE TO COURT CLOSURE OF 9/14/26. BY ORDER OF THE COURT, AND PURSUANT TO RULE 78 OF DISTRICT COURT; JUDGE WILL ISSUE A MINUTE ORDER TODAY OR TOMORROW. 9/28/26***LATER AND BY ORDER OF THE COURT, DEFT/COUNTERCLAIM PLTFF NIKODEM PIKOR'S MOTION FOR RECONSIDERATION OF ORDER GRANTING IN PART AND DENYING IN PART MOTION FOR ATTY'S FEES AND COSTS FILED AUGUST 19, 2026 (DKT.431) IS DENIED. THE MOTION FOR ATTYS' FEES AND COSTS WAS A PRE-JUDGMENT MOTION, DECIDED BEFORE THE FINAL JUDGMENT WAS ENTERED, AND THEREFORE THE 90 DAY LIMITATION OF HRAP RULE 4(a)(3) DOES NOT APPLY. THIS RULING IS MADE WITHOUT A HEARING BASED ON THE WRITTEN SUBMISSION PURSUANT TO RULE 78 OF THE DISTRICT COURT RULES OF CIVIL PROCEDURE.
